messages.subject: MSStats volcano plot labels
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I posted this on the Skyline group and they bumped me over here.  I'm doing DIA with EncyclopeDIA into Skyline and then trying the MSStats implementation in the Skyline portal.  I posted the message below in the Skyline user group:

Hi all,

This might be somewhere and I just didn't find it, but can you help me find out how to control the labels on the MSStats volcano plots creation in the Skyline implementation? Is it possible to use only the gene names or something else instead of like it is in the attached plot?

I hope this isn't a multiply duplicated question that I just didn't find.

Best,

chris

messages.subject: Version above 1.2.7 causes issue with groupComparisonTMT function
messages.subject_clean: Version above 1.2.7 causes issue with groupComparisonTMT function
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am a heavy user of MSstatsTMT and have recently upgraded from version 1.2.7 to version 1.5.6 (Also 1.4.6).

Upon upgrading versions (Up from 1.2.7) I have experienced an issue with MSstatsTMT function groupComparisonTMT. Within the output of groupComparisonTMT I get no Pvalues or Log2FC values and in the "issue" column for all of my proteins I get "unfittableModel". However, using the older version of MSstatsTMT (Version 1.2.7) I am able to get proper statistics (Pvalues and Log2FC values, etc).

To this email I am attaching the input file to groupComparisonTMT as well as the output I get from that function for version 1.2.7 as well as version 1.5.6.

I was wondering if someone could shed some light on why this is happening in the newer versions of MSstatsTMT?

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you,

Trent Hinkle
